desc: Trust from care at the base (Care.trust_up). Petting, its habit food and winning together each raise trust by a named amount, shown to the player as one plain line. Trust stays 0 to 100 and nothing here lowers it. A habit (rec.habit.food) is picked when a Boki hatches, from its element (the species theme).
_units: pet, food, win: trust points (0 to 100). cooldown_h: in-game hours between two raises of one kind on one Boki. hour_s: real seconds in one in-game hour (the home day is 300 s, so 300 / 24).
